moje.wyniki.wysylaj_opis: Every 2 minutes and after each session.
moje.wyniki.jedna_sesja: You can hide a single session in Step history > session details. It then stays only on this computer.
moje.profil.tytul: My profile as others see it
moje.gry.kto: Who sees my results for each game
moje.gry.opis: Others see your total steps, and after a click also your results for each game. You can hide a single game in Settings > Games and controls > Game profiles > (profile) > Show this game on the online account.
moje.haslo.rozne: The new passwords differ. Enter the same one in both fields.
moje.haslo.opis: After a password change, other computers will be signed out.
moje.haslo.zmienione: Password changed. Other computers have been signed out.
moje.konto.zapamietaj_wyl: When this is off, closing WalkLevel signs you out of the account.
moje.konto.pobierz: Download my data from the server
moje.konto.pobrano: Your data from the server is saved in {plik}.
moje.konto.usun_opis: Deleting the account removes it from the server together with your results and friends. Results on this computer stay. Enter your password and hold the button.
moje.konto.usun_brak_hasla: Enter your password to delete the account.
moje.wyslano_nic: All sessions are already on the server.
moje.czeka: {liczba} {liczba, plural, one {session is} other {sessions are}} waiting to be sent.
